N. of a tree; see शोभाञ्जन.

__1 A juggler, conjurer. 
__2 A hunter, fowler;
__1 N. of Hariśchandra's city (said to be suspended in air); हतः सौभपतिः शाल्वस्त्वया सौभं च पाततम् [[

.]] 
__2 N. of a town of the Śālvas; ibid.; [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-पतिः, -राज् a Śālva king; ibid; यथा सौभपतिर्हतः [[

__1 Good luck, happiness. 
__2 Prosperity, riches, wealth.

सौभद्रः,
सौभद्रेयः Epithets of Abhimanyu, son of Subhadrā; सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः [[
The son of a favourite wife.

[सुभगायाः सुभगस्य वा भावः ष्यञ् द्विपदवृद्धिः] 
__1 Good fortune or luck, fortunateness (chiefly consisting in a man's and woman's securing the favour and firm devotion of each other); प्रियेषु सौभाग्यफला हि चारुता [[
]]; (see [[Malli.]]'s remarks on सौभाग्य in both places); युज्यत आत्मनः सौभाग्यं प्रच्छादयितुम् [[

.]] 
__2 Blessedness, auspiciousness; समृद्धं सौभाग्यं सकलवसुधायाः किमपि तत् [[G.

.]] 
__3 Beauty, charm, grace; (यस्य) हिमं न सौभाग्यविलोपि जातम् [[

.]] 
__4 Grandeur, sublimity. 
__5 The auspicious state of wifehood (opp. widowhood). 
__6 Congratulation; good wishes. 
__7 Affection, favour. 
__8 Red-lead. 
__9 Borax. 
-Comp. 
-चिह्नम् 
__1 any mark of good fortune or happiness. 
__2 any sign of the blessed state of wifehood (such as the saffron mark on the forehead). 
-तन्तुः the marriage string (put round the neck of the bride by the bridegroom at the time of marriage and worn by her till widowhood; also called मङ्गलसूत्र q. v.). 
-तृतीया the third day of the bright half of Bhādrapada. 
-देवता an auspicious or tutelary deity. 
-वायनम् an auspicious offering of sweetmeats &c. 
-विलोपिन् a. marring or impairing beauty; अनन्तरत्नप्रभवस्य यस्य हिमं न सौभाग्यविलोपि जातम् [[

a. Fortunate, auspicious. 
-ती A married woman whose husband is alive, a married unwidowed woman.
a. Bringing security and abundance of food.
Good brotherhood, fraternity; सौभ्रात्रमेषां हि कुलानुसारि [[
